claims.statement: The shared BotService creates its Telegram client lazily from the token in the BotConfig named by BotIdentity.Name, throws BotNotConfiguredException when no token is present, keeps the client until ReloadClient drops it, sets webhooks with the bot's secret token, and pauses by deleting the webhook, returning false after logging a non-cancellation failure; it has no resume operation of its own.
TestBot's registration calls AddBotConfig for its named BotConfig and registers its bot, update, database services and command/callback handlers as keyed services under the TestBot name.
TestBot binds its webhook route and keyed update service through a bot-specific controller, while UpdateControllerBase in BotFarm.Core owns the shared POST handling.

The UpdateService base class builds command and callback handler maps from registered handler keys; it invokes a matching handler and completes without an action when no handler is registered for the key.

TestBotUpdateService overrides only OnUpdate to save GIF messages with the chat ID, sender user ID and file ID, skipping messages without a sender user; when saving throws it logs the failure and sends an error notification.

TestBot's clear-chat-data command shows the confirmation prompt only in private chats or to administrators, and its callback rechecks the callback sender before clearing stored chat data, answering a non-admin with an alert.

Bot control state is stored per bot in the BotFarmControl database's BotControlStates collection, keyed by bot name; desired-state updates use MongoDB find-and-update and return the updated authoritative record.

Startup initialization loads each bot's settings and reloads its client before loading its desired state; an unreadable settings store leaves the bot Unknown, a missing desired-state record is seeded disabled, and a bot without usable settings becomes NotConfigured with applied enabled false instead of being applied.

A bot-control command marks runtime status pending and persists a uniquely identified desired-state command before applying the webhook transition; if a MongoDB write has an ambiguous outcome, a read-back matching the command ID confirms persistence, otherwise the bot remains unconfirmed and gated.

The shared update controller dispatches an authenticated update only when the bot control service reports Applied with AppliedEnabled true; otherwise it returns HTTP 503 without processing the update.

Webhook application makes up to three attempts with delays of one and two seconds; a terminal transition failure produces Error status with only the exception type and attempt count, while cancellation or unconfirmed persistence leaves status Unknown, and the update gate stays closed until successful application.

Chat-data clearing allows private chats directly and requires the command sender or callback sender to be a Telegram group administrator; administrator lookup API, HTTP, and timeout failures are logged and deny the action.

RunWithUpdatesPausedAsync pauses an applied, enabled bot before running the maintenance action, throws BotUpdatesPauseException without running it when the pause is not confirmed, and afterwards re-applies the enabled state with a non-cancellable token, alerting admins if the bot ends in Error; a bot without usable settings only runs the action.

PauseAllForShutdownAsync pauses the webhook of each bot with usable settings, only gates bots without them, and leaves every bot Pending so updates stay gated and operator commands are rejected until the host stops.

The UpdateService base class handles a bot command only when it starts the message and the chat is private or the command is addressed to this bot's username, routing /start and /changelanguage to built-in flows and other commands to registered handlers.

UpdateService treats only the MigrateFromChatId notice in the new supergroup as a chat migration, moving the chat's data through IDatabaseService.MigrateChat before calling OnChatMigrated once; a MigrateToChatId notice in the old group goes to OnUpdate without migrating.
When MigrateChat fails during a supergroup upgrade, UpdateService logs an error with both chat IDs, rethrows, and does not call OnChatMigrated; the default OnChatMigrated does nothing.

DropPendingUpdatesAsync discards Telegram's queued updates without changing the bot's enabled state, failing fast with BotControlBusyException when the bot's operation lock is held and with BotNotConfiguredException for a not configured bot.

BotService.DropPendingUpdates re-sets a registered webhook at the same URL with the bot's secret and dropPendingUpdates, and without a webhook deletes it with dropPendingUpdates so the bot stays without one.

A group message whose SenderChat is the group itself is treated as sent by an anonymous administrator and passes the admin check without an administrator lookup, unless a separate callback sender is supplied.
The language-set callback saves the chat language only if the bot has a translation for it; an unsupported language is logged, the callback is acknowledged, and nothing is persisted.
Localized chat strings fall back from the chat's language to the default language, and to an empty string only when the default language lacks the key.

The default Telegram client factory gives Bot API requests a 25-second HTTP timeout, under Telegram's 60-second webhook deadline, and sends every client through one shared handler that recycles pooled connections after 30 seconds idle or five minutes and has cookies off.

BotCommandMenu builds three command lists (default scope with every command, all group chats with Everyone commands, all chat administrators with Everyone and GroupAdmins commands) for the default language and each language file, leaving out commands without a description in that language.
BotCommandMenu throws InvalidOperationException for an invalid command name, a description over 256 characters, a duplicate command in a list, or more than 100 commands in a list.

Enabling a bot registers its command menus after setting the webhook, deleting empty lists; a registration failure is logged with the exception and sent to the admin chat with its type and message without failing enable.
The coordinator records BotEnabled or BotDisabled events only when an operator change ends Applied in a different on/off state, and records PendingUpdatesDropped after a successful drop.
SetEnabledAsync, GetWebhookInfoAsync and DropPendingUpdatesAsync reject a NotConfigured bot with BotNotConfiguredException, while RetryAsync accepts Unknown, Error and NotConfigured bots.
